title: [Feature][Model] Add Qwen3.8 Flash Next support
body:
## Summary

This ports the Qwen3.8 Flash Next support originally developed in #15162 onto the current `main` APIs, while reusing the upstream Qwen4Exp model implementation instead of copying upstream model code into the plugin.

The change adds:

- Ascend wrappers for `Qwen4ExpForCausalLM`, `Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration`, and `Qwen4ExpMTP`;
- A3 QSA/Lightning Indexer support, including the QSA E3 custom operator and Meta registration;
- ModelSlim W8A8 configuration;
- Model Runner V1-only speculative decoding integration through capability protocols rather than scattered model-type checks;
- fixed-address PLE auxiliary inputs for eager and graph execution;
- correct `sigmoid` versus `swish` gating in Ascend's GDN normalization path;
- deployment documentation and focused unit/source-regression coverage.

## Scope and compatibility

- vLLM-Ascend base after rebase: `baa023ada41a5b889cac6249845a688aab130892`
- Model Runner V1 only; no legacy/v0 runner changes are included.
- The pinned vLLM revision contains the authoritative Qwen4Exp model modules consumed by these wrappers. The current vLLM-Ascend release-tag pairing based on vLLM v0.28 does not contain that upstream model owner, so this PR should be reviewed and landed with that dependency boundary in mind.
- A3-only native operator registration remains scoped to the A3 build branch; the A5 operator set is unchanged.

## Validation

- Rebasing onto the above `main` base resolved the speculative proposer, ModelSlim quantization, hybrid KV planner, six-region allocation, cache binding, and gated-norm test conflicts. All 17 PR commits have DCO sign-offs. Changed-file Ruff, repository F821 scan, Python 3.12 `compileall`, and `git diff --check` passed. Full NPU E2E has **not** yet been rerun on this rebased tree; the runtime results below are from the earlier base.
- Related CPU test selection before the latest fix: **283 passed, 13 skipped, 2 failed**. The two failures are the existing Eagle proposer CPU-native tests for `_C_ascend::npu_copy_and_expand_eagle_inputs`; both reproduce unchanged on base `8bd6fe0bc` because that operator has PrivateUse1/Meta registrations but no CPU kernel.
- Explicit non-Qwen PLE runner regression: **10 passed**.
- Changed-file Ruff, Ruff format check, `compileall`, and `git diff --check`: passed for the earlier port. The latest gated-norm change has **3 focused unit tests passed**, syntax/diff checks passed, and its changed-file Ruff import check passed.
- Clean A3 source build passed and installed `vllm_ascend-0.1.dev5377+gbb19443b6`. Post-build wrapper import resolution, native QSA schema registration, and Meta execution passed; the Meta output aliases the supplied output tensor as required. Post-build focused regression: **15 passed**.
- Real A3 W8A8 TP8/DP1 single-request runs with MTP=3 and decode ACL Graph produced normal output. Prefix caching showed real long-prefix hits and identical cold/hit output within prefix-on mode.
- **Prefix-cache parity isolated:** the earlier ON/OFF comparison used different prefill partitions (`[2304, 96]` versus `[2400]`) and did not isolate cache restoration. With matched `[2304, 96]` partitions, all 16 generated tokens, token logprobs, and 3421 sampled TP0 layer-trace events matched. Real hits at 2304 and 1536 also matched same-partition cold runs exactly. Prefix-cache restoration passed these eager, MTP-off cases; partition-dependent numerical behavior remains a separate open risk.
- The **upstream vLLM** QSA metadata fix for Graph-padded decode is proposed in [vllm-project/vllm#58040](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/58040). It clamps the mapped-token count to the real token count and fixes the no-MTP Graph crash observed in this experiment. It is **not included in this vLLM-Ascend PR**; no-MTP Graph validation requires that upstream fix until it lands.

## Notes

Repository-wide Ruff currently reports two pre-existing import-order findings in untouched E2E files. This change does not modify those files.

- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/544f182d9f0c9bfe8bd7645525951d5e3692a542
